description: This file contains definitions and recipes related to the build process of Chromium OS, including kernel partition handling, bootloader configurations, and device-specific build settings for Google WiFi (Gale). It defines custom build steps, device configurations, and references external tools like cros-vbutil and various kernel modules.

methods.name: Build/cros-gpt
methods.description: Build recipe that copies the target file to a temporary file, generates a GPT partition table using ptgen, and appends its output to the target.

methods.name: Build/append-kernel-part
methods.description: Appends the kernel image to the target file using dd with specified block size.

methods.name: Build/cros-vboot
methods.description: Creates a verified boot image by invoking cros-vbutil to sign the kernel and updates the target file atomically.

methods.name: Device/google_wifi
methods.description: Device configuration defining vendor, model, SOC, kernel, images, and associated packages for a Google WiFi device.
